name: +12V BATT
circuit: Main supply from the Class-T, 150 A max

name: GND
circuit: Device ground and flyback return for every inductive load
note: Shortest, heaviest wire on the plate

name: +12V SW
circuit: Wake input — diode-OR strip: ACC · RUN · door stage (A6) · horn/hazard/wink stage (A8) · O22 latch
note: 10 kΩ bleed to GND on the rail

name: +5V OUT
circuit: +5 V reference — plate only: the two 100 kΩ bias resistors for A15 / A16
note: Nothing in any leg uses +5 V

name: CAN1H
circuit: Laptop / config bus, 1 Mbps. 120 Ω at BOTH ends (PMU end + port)

name: CAN1L
circuit: Laptop / config bus

name: CAN2H
circuit: Vehicle bus 500 kbps — software termination ON at the PMU, 120 Ω at the engine-bay drop
note: Only the L1 drop is live now; the three dash drops are capped

name: CAN2L
circuit: Vehicle bus

name: MOTOR_BUS
circuit: Pop-up motor bus — feeds fuse block C (F6 / F7 → K1 / K2 contacts) and both K1 / K2 coils
goes_to: Block C in · K1 86 · K2 86 · L4-P 3 (capped)
note: Integrated flyback diode on this channel. Stalls measured: L 12.8 A · R 13.1 A

name: HEAD_LOW
circuit: Headlight LOW, both lamps

name: HEAD_HIGH
circuit: Headlight HIGH, both lamps + the cluster high-beam indicator

name: DEFOG
circuit: Rear defog grid — wired; channel configured and DISABLED (no control surface in this build)

name: FUEL_PUMP
circuit: Fuel pump — Carter P4070

name: IGNITION
circuit: Ignition — coils and igniters; also the F15 alternator-excitation branch and the F16 cluster branch

name: LS_ECU
circuit: Reserved for the LS swap — ECU + injectors

name: LS_FAN
circuit: Reserved for the LS swap — cooling fan

name: COMFORT
circuit: Comfort bus — fuse block D (F10 / F11, empty) and the capped dash feed. No live load this build

name: BLOWER
circuit: Blower motor (new motor — speed selected by the resistor pack and switch on the ground side)
note: Integrated flyback diode. Expect 12–18 A on HI

name: TAIL_PARK
circuit: Tail · park · side markers · licence

name: BRAKE
circuit: Brake lamps

name: WIPE_LOW
circuit: Wiper LOW brush — braking channel; also feeds K12 (washer) contact 30
note: Braking ON. Park sense arrives on A3

name: WIPE_HIGH
circuit: Wiper HIGH brush

name: ACCESSORY
circuit: Accessory bus — head unit (ACC), USB-C, K12 coil; three capped module drops

name: HORN
circuit: Horns, both

name: TURN_L
circuit: Turn LEFT front + rear + cluster indicator — flashed in the PMU

name: TURN_R
circuit: Turn RIGHT front + rear + cluster indicator

name: REVERSE
circuit: Reverse lamps

name: INTERIOR
circuit: Interior lamp (via F12, PWM theatre fade) + illumination bus (dash lamps, cluster, head unit)

name: START_RLY
circuit: Start relay K9 coil

name: KEEP_ALIVE
circuit: Keep-alive — feeds the wake strip through a diode and drives K11 (audio master)

name: HEADLIGHT_SW
circuit: Headlight switch ladder — OFF / PARK / HEAD-LO / HEAD-HI / PASS (12 V side, 12-bit)
note: Occupies O23. 10 kΩ pull-down + 100 kΩ bias from +5 V

name: KEY_POS
circuit: Key ladder — OFF / ACC / RUN / START (summed, 12 V side, 12-bit)
note: Occupies O24. 10 kΩ pull-down + 100 kΩ bias

name: TURN_STALK
circuit: Turn stalk — LEFT / OFF / RIGHT

name: WIPER_STALK
circuit: Wiper stalk — WASH / HIGH / LOW / INT / OFF

name: BRAKE_PARK
circuit: Brake pedal + wiper park sense — 4 states

name: POPUP_L
circuit: Pop-up LEFT transit contact + inhibitor P/N contact

name: POPUP_R
circuit: Pop-up RIGHT transit contact + inhibitor R contact

name: DOOR_PINS
circuit: Door jamb switches, driver + passenger — 4 states
note: 10 kΩ pull-up. Also sensed by wake stage 1

name: FUEL_LEVEL
circuit: Fuel sender tap — the factory gauge drives the sender; the PMU only reads the node
goes_to: Tap on the L4-S 1 → DP-CLU 7 conductor
note: 1 MΩ pull-down, no pull-up. Calibrate in the car

name: HAZ_HORN_WINK
circuit: Hazard · horn · wink L · wink R — one summed ladder
note: 10 kΩ pull-up. Also sensed by wake stage 2
